attempts.why: Use Selectors Level 4 'of S' syntax to exclude [hidden] rows from striping count so visible rows alternate correctly.

selfVerify.reason: Striping alternates correctly on visible rows: Apples shaded, Pears white, Plums shaded, Figs white. Even with a [hidden] row in the DOM, no two adjacent visible rows share the same background, so the :nth-child(of S) exclusion is working and no regression is visible.

pick.suspected: Striped table uses tbody tr:nth-child(even/odd) which counts the hidden (display:none) row, so two adjacent visible rows get the same background instead of alternating.
